purpose: Hotfix workflow-copy packaging failure inherited from v0.6 installer.
root_cause: v1.0 inherited Installer/01_INSTALL_AND_PREPARE_TEST.bat from v0.6, which still attempted to copy 02_ConceptGhost_CG02_CG03_PANORAMA_v0.6.json even though that file was no longer in the bundle.
fixes: Installer now references the workflow version present in the bundle.
Workflow source files are checked before copy.
Installer tries all standard ComfyUI workflow directories instead of failing on the first unwritable one.
Copied workflow is verified after copy.
Verifier explicitly checks for Workflow 02 v1.1.
Graph behavior is unchanged from v1.0.
